description: DREAL Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes: public transport datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by DREAL Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes. Coverage: DREAL Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes. The listing groups 4 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about public transport; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Pylones du Réseau de Transport d'Electricité de RTE en Auvergne-Rhône-; Postes du Réseau de Transport d'Electricité de RTE en Auvergne-Rhône-A; Lignes du Réseau de Transport d Electricite aérien de RTE d'Auvergne-R; Lignes du Réseau de Transport d Electricite souterrain de RTE d'Auverg. Formats seen: WFS, ZIP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
